verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Serverless/Standard clusters can be created in seconds via the `ccloud quickstart` CLI or Cloud API with autoscaling Request Units (scales to zero, no capacity planning needed), and `cockroach demo`/single-node start offer instant local ready-to-connect databases. missing for 10: no independent hands-on timing benchmark or third-party confirmation of the 'seconds' claim, and no explicit API (REST/Terraform) walkthrough beyond CLI docs.
